scope: Controlled DXF generated by the in-tree writer for the owned-XRECORD-extension control. Compare its default plot-style graph under AC1015, AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024, each in ASCII and Binary. No imported source drawing is included.

observed.comparison: All eight files have equal decoded NOD, default-dictionary and placeholder ordered group values. Names and string values were kept exact; numeric values and handles were decoded for comparison. Generated handle remapping was not exercised.
observed.nod: DICTIONARY C has owner 0, and ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME group 350 targets E.
observed.dictionaryWithDefault: ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT E has owner C, AcDbDictionary group 281=1, key Normal group 350 targeting F, and AcDbDictionaryWithDefault group 340 targeting F. Group 280 is absent; there are no reactors, extension dictionary or XDATA groups.
observed.placeholder: ACDBPLACEHOLDER F has exactly group 5=F and owner group 330=E; no additional groups.
observed.classes: Both classes have their canonical record/class/application names, proxy=0, zombie=0 and entity=0. AC1015 omits instance-count group 91 and reads as 0; AC1018, AC1021 and AC1024 carry group 91=1 for both classes.
observed.importProbe: In each generated file the in-tree importer reports one LAYER with plot handle F, one typed and one raw default dictionary, zero typed and one raw placeholder, and one successful dictionary-default import receipt. The AC1015 raw carriers remain bound to source version AC1015.

failureBoundary.observed: The owned-extension selector's AC1015 DXF source to AC1018 DXF attempt fails during the dictionary-with-default OBJECTS callback. The adapter attempts raw DICTIONARYWDFLT replay; writeRawDxfObjectInternal rejects a non-UNKNOWN source version that differs from the target. The seeded/previous destination is retained, so it is not a successful target readback.
failureBoundary.baseline: The same failure reproduced using the exact a69b3579 adapter and test source. This observation does not diagnose XRECORD payload corruption.

existingCode.profileGate: prepareDxfLayerPlot's existing default-only typed dictionary path is explicitly AC1021 source to AC1021 target. It validates the typed dictionary, source raw dictionary and root/layer relationship; it is not a cross-version qualification.
existingCode.placeholderGap: The current placeholder callback still uses same-version raw replay, including when the default-only dictionary path is active. The existing default graph predicate checks raw placeholder identity/owner but does not establish that the entire raw placeholder body has only the two witnessed groups.
existingCode.classPath: registerDictionaryDefaultClasses can normalize a recognized selected class alias and emitted instance count, while codec caller-plot handling validates selected identities and owners. A new source-bound profile must still prove the source CLASS pair and its version-specific count representation and audit the resulting target CLASS records.

Emit the validated typed dictionary and a bounded typed placeholder through the existing caller-owned default-plot reservation. Prove source-to-output aliases and target CLASS rows, including target instance count 1; inspect the staged NOD edge, both emitted objects and all owner/reference roles before atomic publication.

Exercise both ASCII/Binary sources and targets, nonidentity remaps where permitted, duplicate/extra placeholder fields, role or target changes, source/class mutations before and after staging, missing objects and destination-preserving same-adapter retry. Keep generic raw cross-version replay refused and rerun the owning XRECORD extension selector only after graph proof is complete.
limitations: Both source and target examples were produced by the same in-tree writer; ezdxf only independently read their tags. They are not independent native-producer or consumer evidence and cannot qualify default-plot semantic equivalence.
